thread:
alina.sales: Heads-up — SentinelHealth RFP just arrived asking for connectivity options for a 2-week POC, minimum commercial commit if they go Private, and a short technical capability matrix. Doc uploaded: https://drive.company/sentinel_rfp.pdf. Who can do quick bullets?

infra-bot: Uploaded file `sentinel_rfp.pdf` (1.8MB) to #sales thread.

marc.eng: I can handle tech bullets. Quick plan: offer two POC paths — Hosted quickstart (3-10 day) and Private VPC (2-4 week). For ingestion we support presigned S3 URLs or cross-account IAM role; presigned recommended for one-off imports. We'll include a Terraform snippet for cross-account role if they want automation.

rachel.sec: Security must include BAA/DPA for PHI, customer-managed KMS for hosted POCs, audit logging, and an option for log-redaction. Presigned URLs must be read-only and rotated for repeated batches. Also note: for Private/HSM we support FIPS/HSM keys with a separate SOW.

tom.finance: Commercial bullets: propose POC credit $7,000 covering hosted work and first 400GB ingress/egress. Private short-term commit: $16k/month (30-day min). Egress overage $0.11/GB. Include statement that long-term Dedicated pricing will be provided after the POC based on usage.

alina.sales: Can someone draft single-line answers for RFP fields I can paste? Need: ingestion, residency, kms/hsm, retention, egress, attachments, exec summary.

marc.eng: Drafts below — copy/paste ready.
"Ingestion": "Customer may supply data via presigned S3 URLs (recommended, TTL 24h) or a cross-account read-only IAM role; we can provide Terraform for automation.",
"Residency": "Hosted POCs store data in the tenant's selected region; Private/VPC or on-prem options are available for strict residency requirements.",
"KMS/HSM": "We support customer-managed KMS for hosted deployments; HSM-backed key material (FIPS) available in Private/on-prem with SOW.",
"Retention": "Default POC artifacts retention: 14 days (logs retained 30 days). Shorter retention can be configured for sensitive data on request.",
"Egress": "POC covers first 400GB ingress/egress; additional egress billed at $0.11/GB. Private deployments follow customer/provider egress billing.",
"Attachments": "pricing sheet, standard BAA/DPA, POC SOW template, and a sample runbook (uploaded).",
"Exec summary": "Redwood will execute a short POC to validate integration, performance, and security posture. Options: quick hosted baseline or Private VPC for data-sensitive evaluation. Deliverables: KPI report and recommended serving configuration."

rachel.sec: Edits: presign must be read-only and rotated for multi-batch ingestion. Add security contact: rachel.sec@redwood.ai. Also change log retention note to emphasize audit logs are immutable for 30 days.

tom.finance: Confirm commercial numbers above. I'll attach the pricing sheet now.

infra-bot: Uploaded file `sentinel_poc_pricing_v1.xlsx` (26KB).

alina.sales: Awesome — I'll assemble and send to the customer. Goal: ship in the next 3 hours. Thanks team :thumbsup:
